title: SecureDatagramChannel.send_message silently drops messages on admission key mismatch
description:
In channel.py lines 1056-1063, when send_message() detects that a message was admitted for peer A but is being sent to peer B, it finishes the operation for peer A and returns without sending the message. No exception is raised and no warning is logged.

Failure scenario: If aiocoap or application code accidentally reuses a Message object for a different destination after admission, the second send is silently dropped with no indication.

Suggested fix: Log a warning before returning, e.g., logger.warning('message admitted for %s but sent to %s; dropping', admission_key, key)

File: src/lichen/coap/secure/channel.py
Line: 1056-1063
